name: agent-skill-marketplace
description: Agent Skill Marketplace for AI Discoverability, Machine Readiness, Factual Freshness, and On-site Engagement Auditing.
author: Adobe University Hackathon 2026 Team

skills.name: audit-orchestrator
skills.description: Sole designated entrypoint that coordinates audit requests, executes specialist skills, deduplicates findings, calibrates severity, and compiles the final structured audit report.

skills.name: crawl-render-audit
skills.description: Audits HTTP accessibility, robots.txt, sitemaps, crawlability, raw server HTML vs rendered DOM content deltas, and machine-readable metadata.

skills.name: freshness-corroboration
skills.description: Audits temporal freshness signals, copyright recency, factual consistency across pages, and entity identity statements.

skills.name: engagement-audit
skills.description: Audits on-site human/agent engagement factors: above-the-fold value proposition clarity, navigation hierarchy, subpage context retention, and CTA discoverability.
